description: This is a test class for the HelpService component within the OrangeHRM Help plugin, specifically testing various functionalities such as retrieving help configuration, processing help articles via Zendesk, and URL validation.

classes.name: HelpServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the HelpService, verifying functionalities like URL retrieval, configuration, and helper methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, setting up HelpService instance and fixtures.

methods.name: testGetHelpConfigService
methods.description: Verifies that getHelpConfigService returns an instance of HelpConfigService.

methods.name: testGetZendeskHelpProcessor
methods.description: Checks that getHelpProcessor returns an instance of ZendeskHelpProcessor.

methods.name: testGetRedirectUrl
methods.description: Tests the getRedirectUrl method with mocked HTTP response returning a specific help article URL.

methods.name: testGetRedirectUrl2
methods.description: Tests getRedirectUrl with a response indicating no articles, expecting the default help URL.

methods.name: testGetDefaultRedirectUrl
methods.description: Checks that getDefaultRedirectUrl returns the correct default URL.

methods.name: testIsValidUrl
methods.description: Tests if the current help URL configured in the system is valid.

methods.name: testIsValidUrl2
methods.description: Simulates an invalid base help URL to verify validation logic.
